hypothesis.statement: In GaitRec healthy controls (n=208, ages 15-78), the vertical-GRF push-off peak declines with age (negative OLS slope); the newly-authored linearRegression reproduces base R stats::lm and scipy.stats.linregress bit-for-bit for the slope, R-squared and slope p-value.

analysis_plan.dataset: GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020); vertical-GRF push-off peak (3rd landmark of PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) regressed on age in healthy controls, shod, standardised speed, initial-presentation baseline sessions

decision.threshold: descriptive: linearRegression equals scipy.stats.linregress bit-for-bit (|diff| = 0) and base R lm to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9) for the slope and R-squared; the slope is negative (push-off declines with age) and significant (p < 0.001)
